policy: When Black has any next-move standing four-three or open four and no immediate five, cover every attack with a direct White block. Retain existing choices; add quiet blocks of uncovered attacks, each followed by a fixed finish at another attack point: a standing four-three, or an open four played out to five. At most nine choices, prioritizing occupation of attack points and coverage of every side before additional nearby blocks; when nine are not enough, a choice whose attacks another choice covers makes way.
